BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to information an employer must disclose to anapplicant for employment; and adding a new section to chapter 49.46RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An employer shall provide the following information to anapplicant for a position of employment: (a) The nature of the work; (b) The hours of work expected each week; (c) The wage rate paid for each hour; (d) Any benefits provided, including but not limited to healthinsurance, sick leave, vacation leave, and child care; (e) The conditions of work, including but not limited to availableshifts and meal and rest breaks; (f) Any required alcohol or controlled substances testing; and (g) Any required uniforms as defined in RCW 49.12.450 or otherrequired apparel. p. 1 HB 2159 (2) The employer must provide the information specified insubsection (1) of this section to the applicant in writing, and withintwentyfour hours of receiving his or her application for the positionof employment. (3) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Employer" means a person who had ten or more fulltimeequivalent employees in the previous year; and (b) "Position" means a position of employment paying less than onehundred fifty percent of the minimum wage rate calculated under RCW49.46.020. (4) The legislature declares that the public policies articulatedin this section depend on the procedures established in this sectionand no civil or criminal action may be maintained relying on the publicpolicies articulated in this section without complying with theprocedures set forth in this section, and to that end all civil actionsand civil causes of action for such injuries and all jurisdiction ofthe courts of this state over such causes are hereby abolished, exceptas provided in this section.
